verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents built-in MFA (enrollment/challenge/verify flows with app-level enforcement guidance) and enterprise SSO for SAML 2.0 identity providers (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, Auth0) targeting application end-users, directly matching the platform-engineer/auth story [supabase-docs-44, supabase-docs-45, supabase-supp-auth-mfa, supabase-supp-auth-sso-saml]. However, only SAML is explicitly documented — no evidence of native OIDC support for application users — and enforcement is described as 'app-level guidance' rather than a platform-enforced mandatory policy, with no independent/hands-on corroboration of these flows working end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit OIDC support for app users, concrete platform-level mandatory-enforcement mechanism, and independent/community verification of MFA+SSO enforcement in production.
